decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed single-storey side extension, by reason of its design, scale and siting would form a visually intrusive addition that would be poorly integrated with the existing property and surrounding context and would fail to appear subservient to the host property overall. The proposal is therefore considered to cause harm to the character, appearance, setting and significance of the subject property and terrace as well as the Dover House Estate Conservation Area contrary to the aims of policies LP1, LP3 and LP5 of the Local Plan (2023), policy HC1 (C) of the London Plan (2021), the Housing SPD (2016), the Historic Environment SPD (2016) and the Dover House Estate Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy, without there being any justification for the harm caused or demonstratable public benefits to outweigh this harm, contrary to the provisions of the NPPF (2024) and the objectives of Section 72 (1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.

Reason : 2 - The proposed single-storey rear extension, by reason of its scale and siting would result in the overdevelopment of the site, resulting in an unacceptable loss of functional private outdoor amenity space for current and future occupants of the subject property and would result in an unacceptable impact on neighbouring amenity, contrary to policies LP1, LP2 and LP5 of the Local Plan (2023), the Housing SPD (2016) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

Reason : 3 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
description: Erection of a single-storey side extension and a single-storey ground  floor rear extension.
